story.iWant: to search across all content in current dashboard tab
story.soThat: I can quickly find specific articles, papers, or deals
story.tasks: - Add search input component to each tab layout - Implement client-side filtering using Dash callbacks - Use case-insensitive substring matching (no complex indexing needed) - Highlight matches using HTML `` tags - Search state persists within session per tab - Ensure search works with existing filter combinations

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - Given I'm viewing any dashboard tab with content, when I type a search query in the search box, then results update in real-time (<1 second) - And search matches against: title, description, source name, tags/categories - And matching terms are highlighted in results - And I can clear search with one click - And search works within already-filtered results

constraints.constraint: Search performance must handle 10,000+ items per tab with <1 second response time
Search must work within existing filter combinations (source, date range, category filters)
Client-side only search (no server-side indexing) to maintain simplicity
Search state persists within session per tab, not across tabs
Search input components use Bootstrap styling consistent with existing dashboard theme

tests.standards: Search functionality tested using Playwright for UI interaction and real-time filtering. Performance testing verifies sub-second response times with 10K items. Cross-browser compatibility testing ensures consistent behavior across Chrome, Firefox, Safari.

ideas.idea: Test: Type search query in 4 tabs and verify real-time filtering updates results within 1 second
Test: Search with sample data and verify matches are found in title, description, source name, and tags/categories
Test: Verify HTML `` tags are applied correctly to highlight matching terms in results
Test: Click clear search button and verify all content returns to unfiltered state and search input is emptied
Test: Apply existing filters first (e.g., source filter), then search and verify search operates on pre-filtered results
Test: Load 10,000 items and verify search performance remains under 1 second for various query lengths
